description: Introduce extensible history without editing the applied bootstrap ledger or migration.
statements: CREATE TABLE audit.migration_history (migration_id text PRIMARY KEY, sha256 text NOT NULL CHECK (sha256 ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$'), applied_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT clock_timestamp(), applied_by text NOT NULL DEFAULT current_user)
REVOKE ALL ON audit.migration_history FROM PUBLIC
INSERT INTO audit.migration_history (migration_id, sha256, applied_at, applied_by) SELECT migration_id, sha256, applied_at, applied_by FROM audit.schema_migration
